answer: Burn the attestation when a recruited identity misbehaves, not just the identity. Each TEE quote is a crystal tied to one physical enclave, so a bad recruit costs its recruiter that enclave permanently, and a quorum counts only when its quotes come from unrelated subnetworks. A referral chain is a terrace: each level stands on the one below, and one bad quote at the base takes the whole set down. A thousand clean enclaves must stay clean for the entire voyage, which is the expensive part.
